args.title: Fix: re-raise exceptions in get_or_compute instead of silently returning stale value
args.body:
## Problem
`get_or_compute` was silently swallowing exceptions from the `compute` function and returning the previous cached value (`_last`). This caused dashboards to show stale data during outages with no visible indication of failure.

## Fix
Changed the `except Exception` block to re-raise the exception instead of returning the stale value. This ensures callers are immediately aware of compute failures.

## Changes
- `src/cache.py`: Replace `return _last` in the except block with `raise`

## Test
`tests/test_cache.py::test_compute_failure_contract` now passes — it verifies that a `ValueError` raised by the compute function propagates to the caller.
